transcript: Maj. Thorne: So, criminals took hold of your company because of the weak password?
Victim: But it wasn't a weak password!
Victim: It had letters! It had numbers! It was long! They must have some weird mental powers to read it straight from my mind!
Victim: Good grief! She has that power too!

fail_fact.title: Passwords are to secure things — Can you guess one?
text: In July 2025, a US burger company had "123456" as a default password in their recruitment platform. It's estimated some 64 million applications were exposed to the world, for all to read.
Do you want all your CV:s to be read by every hacker?
